questions.question: Who among the following had written Kitab-ul-Hind that gave an incisive description of early 11th Century India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Al-Biruni.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Al-Biruni** was an Iranian scholar.
 
• He is considered the **father of modern geodesy.**
 
• **Kitab-ul-Hind** is an Arabic book authored by Al-Biruni in the 11th century.
 
 
• Kitab-ul-Hind is also known by the name of **Tarikh-ul-Hind.**
 
• The book deals with the “**caste system” in India.**
 
• He extensively compared the Indian culture with other cultures in this book.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Al-Biruni called** Kerala as Malabar.**
 
• Kitab al-Tafhim is the book authored by Al-Biruni in both Persian and Arabic languages.
 
• He traveled to the Indian subcontinent in **1017.**
 
• Notable work of Al-Biruni are: 
 
 
• *The Remaining Signs of Past Centuries.*
 
• *Gems.*
 
• *The Mas'udi Canon.*
 
• *Understanding Astrology.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Al-Bukhari **was a Persian Islamic scholar who was born in Bukhara.
 
• **Al-Khwarizmi **was a Muslim mathematician who introduced Hindu-Arabic numerals and the concepts of algebra into European mathematics.
 
• **Al-Kindi **is popularly called “the philosopher of the Arabs.”

questions.question: Which of the following is the application of sciences such as physics, chemistry, biology, computer science and engineering to matters of law and to the identification of various facts of civilian investigation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Forensic science.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forensic science** is the use of scientific methods or expertise to investigate crimes or examine evidence that might be presented in a court of law.
 
• It is also known as **criminalistics.**
 
• It is the application of sciences such as physics, chemistry, biology, computer science, and engineering to matters of law and to the identification of various facts of the civilian investigation.
 
• Forensic science comprises a diverse array of disciplines, from fingerprint and DNA analysis to anthropology and wildlife forensics.
 
• Forensic scientists collect, preserve, and analyze **scientific evidence** during the course of an investigation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Psychology** is the scientific study of the mind and behavior.
 
• **Morphology **is the study of the size, shape, and structure of animals, plants, and microorganisms and of the relationships of their constituent parts.
 
• **Kalology** is the study of beauty and the ways in which beauty influences society.

questions.question: As per the Union Budget of 2021-22, how many regional national institutes of virology will be set up?

questions.question: Unique Transaction Reference number is a ______ character code used to uniquely identify a transaction in the RTGS system.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**22.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• RTGS stands for **Real-Time Gross Settlements.**
 
• RTGS is a system where there is a continuous and real-time settlement of fund transfers, individually on a transaction-by-transaction basis.
 
• Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number is a **22 character **code used to uniquely identify a transaction in the RTGS system.
 
• **The unique Transaction Reference number** is used to identify a specific bank transaction in India.
 
• All banks in India use UTR numbers for all types of money transfers.
 
• UTR numbers can recognize and keep an eye on financial transactions.
 
• NEFT transactions UTR numbers are **16 characters** long.
 
• Example of a UTR number: **XXXXRCYYYYMMDD########**
 
 
• **XXXX** indicates IFSC (this is the first 4 characters) and is the bank code of the sender.
 
• **R** indicates the RTGS system.
 
• **C **indicates the transaction channel.
 
• **YYYYMMDD** indicates the date of the transaction in this order: year, month, and day.
 
• **########** indicates the sequence number.

questions.question: Which of the following is a process in which hot, less dense materials rise upward and are replaced by colder, more dense materials?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Convection.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Convection** is a mode of heat transfer by the actual motion of matter.
 
• Convection is a process in which hot, less dense materials rise upward and are replaced by colder, more dense materials.
 
• Convection is possible only in **fluids.**
 
• Convection can be either be **natural or forced.**
 
• **Gravity** plays a major role in natural convection.
 
• Material is forced to move by a pump or by some other physical means in forced convection.
 
• Forced-air heating systems in the home, the **human circulatory system** are the common examples of forced convection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The three distinct modes of heat transfer are:
 
 
• Conduction.
 
• Convection.
 
• Radiation.
 
 
 
• The process of heat transfer without any medium is called **radiation.**
 
• **Conduction** is the process of heat transfer between two adjacent parts of a body due to their temperature difference.
 
• **Condensation** is the process where water vapor becomes liquid.

__
 
• **PM WANI**__ stands for Prime Minister Wi-Fi Access Network Interface.
 
• PM-WANI is a scheme aimed at helping accelerate the uptake of broadband internet services.
 
• The initiative aims to elevate** wireless internet connectivity in the country.**
 
• The PM-WANI scheme was announced by the **Department of Telecommunications.**
 
• The government aims to provide internet connectivity through Public Data Offices (PDOs) as a part of the WANI scheme.
 
• Under this scheme,** no license fee **will be charged for providing broadband internet services.
 
• The WANI framework contains the following components:
 
 
• Public Data Office (PDO).
 
• Public Data Office Aggregator (PDOA).
 
• App Provider.
 
• Central Registry.

questions.question: ______ is the structural and functional unit of kidney.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nephron.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kidneys** are bean-shaped organs in the human body.
 
• **Excretion** is the major function of the kidney.
 
• Kidney act as the** filter of the body.**
 
• **Nephron**__ is the structural and functional unit of the kidney.
 __
 
• The cup-shaped part of the nephron is called the** bowman's capsule.**
 
• Nephron composed of a renal corpuscle and a renal tubule
 
• There are around 1,000,000 nephrons in each human kidney.
 
 
 
• The study of kidneys is called** nephrology.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **cortex** is the outermost layer of the brain.
 
• The **ureter** is a tube that carries urine from the kidney to the urinary bladder.
 
• **Medulla **is the terminal part of the brainstem.

questions.question: Electron-volt is a unit of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**energy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The electron volt is the unit of **energy**__ commonly used in atomic and nuclear physics.

 __
 
• The amount of energy gained by the charge of a single electron moved across an electric potential difference of 1 volt is called an **electron volt.**
 
• It is commonly used in atomic and nuclear physics applications.
 
• The symbol of electron volt is **eV.**
 
• **1eV = 1.602×10-19 J**
 
• **1eV = 1.602 × 10−12 erg**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Other units of energy are:
 
 
• **Joule** is the SI unit of Energy.

 
 
• The unit Joule is named after the English physicist James Prescott Joule.
 
• Kg⋅m²⋅s⁻² is the SI base unit of Joule.
 
 
 
• **The calorie **is a unit of energy commonly used in nutrition.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Watt** is the SI unit of Power.

 
 
• The unit watt is named after scientist James Watt.
 
 
 
• **Volt** is the SI unit of potential difference.
 
• **Ampere** is the SI unit of current.
